name: Default List Splitter
helpText:
A ready-made, no-code splitter for the common case where the incoming payload is already a java.util.List - it does no transformation, it just unwraps the list into one message per item.

  • Input- A single payload that is itself a list of 1 to n objects
  • Output- 1 to n separate messages, each message containing one of the objects from that list, in the same order
Input  Output 
MessagePayload MessagePayload
1“AA”, “BB”, “CC” 1“AA”
   2“BB”
   3“CC”

If you need to derive the split items rather than just unwrap an existing list (e.g. splitting a String on a delimiter, or splitting one object into several different objects), use the Splitter component instead - it lets you write that logic yourself.
allowableProperties_comment: Note that the order of properties in this file dictates the order displayed on screen, unless propertyDisplayOrder is set, which will be used as the primary key

componentName.helpText: The name of the component as displayed on diagrams. The name should be unique for the flow. The name will be used internally to reflect the bean created.
